subject.title: fix(status): LINE /status intermittent no-response — fallback, timeout, and retry hardening

question: Should `/status` have a repository-wide 10-second render deadline, or should timeout handling be limited to the LINE delivery path that motivated this PR?
rationale: The modified helper is shared by text commands, native slash fast paths, inline actions, and plugin SDK calls, so the timeout changes cross-channel product behavior rather than only repairing the reported LINE path.

options.title: Narrow to LINE
options.body: Keep generic loader retry hardening but enforce a deadline only where LINE reply-token constraints justify it.

options.title: Adopt shared deadline
options.body: Keep the repository-wide cutoff only after caller-wide proof confirms that replacing slow successful responses is desired.

recommendation.title: Narrow to LINE
recommendation.body: Keep generic loader retry hardening but enforce a deadline only where LINE reply-token constraints justify it.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows direct ownership of the shared status command implementation and its current caller boundary.
